# Hi, I'm Brandon 👋

I build self-hosted software and the platform it runs on. Most of what I make starts as an itch — automating my media library, my desk, the small fleet of machines behind it — and gets polished until someone else can run it too.

Day-to-day work happens on a self-hosted GitLab, so the contribution graph here is the tip of the iceberg.

---

## Built & shipped

**[MKV Auto](https://github.com/MKV-Auto/mkv-auto-release)** — insert a Blu-ray, UHD, or DVD; get an organized, Plex- or Jellyfin-ready library. Disc identification via TheDiscDB, per-episode metadata via TMDB, MakeMKV under the hood — one Docker container, no cloud dependency.

**[Odyssey G9 KVM](https://github.com/acrossthesnow/streamdeck-g9-kvm)** — one-button input switching for the Samsung Odyssey G9's built-in KVM, from a Stream Deck via DDC/CI. Video and peripherals follow together, the second computer needs zero software, and the G9 DDC values Samsung doesn't document are finally written down somewhere.

**[TitleForge](https://github.com/acrossthesnow/TitleForge)** — resolves messy movie and TV filenames against TMDB, then lets you review every move in a terminal UI before anything touches your library.

---

## The homelab

Everything above runs on a homelab I treat like production — hosts, ingress, and deploys all defined in git and shipped by push-based CI. House rule: anything may read, only git may write.

---
